scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0127; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target-bearing learner lines ‘Yes. We can talk here.’ and ‘We can talk after class.’ are grammatical and natural for the bounded talk sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps talk to «صحبت کردن» and preserves the intended meaning across dialogue and activities.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical target is recognized, practiced in two guided exchanges, checked for listening/meaning, transferred, and retrieved with the answer hidden.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors are short A1 alternatives with plausible surface form but clearly different meaning; none duplicates the keyed answer.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: مایا و الکس بعد از کلاس دنبال جای مناسبی برای یک گفت‌وگوی کوتاه هستند.

difficultyFit.evidence: Learner production stays short and controlled; no new grammar claim is added and only one lexical target is scored.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: talk recurs across recognition, guided speech, comprehension, transfer, and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner response changes the time context while preserving the same bounded sense of talk.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, construction, scenario, learner turns, activities, and retrieval align to one lexical objective.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; perceived engagement and difficulty remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded lexical sense defined for this Lesson is reviewed.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: English turns, accepted speech strings, and response options were checked for grammar and internal consistency.
Persian orthography and English–Persian meaning consistency were checked.
Reference key, part of speech, sense key, and provisional spec hash were cross-checked against the worker packet.
Final retrieval keeps the answer hidden before attempt.
Story arc returns after 5 Lessons and learner role changes from the prior scene.

The target-collocation audit found the prompt ‘Can we talk now?’ lacked committed corpus coverage; an explicit lesson-specific usage fallback with a naturalness rationale was added without changing the learner-facing text.
